title: [Suite autour de Teichmüller dont] Teichmülleries, 1981-1982 : notes manuscrites (1981-1983, s.d.), lettres (1981, s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (continuing pp. 80-81). P is a combinatorial n-gon with vertex set S, edge set A and dihedral automorphism group D_P (order 2n). It is realised on a Riemann sphere Σ: the vertices lie on the equator and are punctured, so Σ* = Σ minus S. The faces are the two hemispheres, with centres the poles, and P_ω is the pole for the orientation ω. τ is complex conjugation, the reflection in the equator. D_P acts holomorphically: ω acts as rotation about the polar axis, and each 'reflection' of P acts as a half-turn about an equatorial axis. Grothendieck works with fundamental groupoids/groups of Σ* with these symmetries adjoined, elements written as pairs (path from P_ω to γ(P_ω), γ):
- Π_P = π_1(Σ*, P_ω), free on n loops ρ_s with ρ_{n-1}…ρ_0 = 1.
- Π_P^τ, generated by the τ_a with τ_a^2 = 1; it is the free product of n copies of Z/2.
- Π_P^D, adjoining D_P.
- Π_P^{D,τ}, adjoining D_P×{1,τ}.

This page. On p.81 the stabiliser of P_ω in D_P×{1,τ} was found to be {g̃° = (g, τ^{α(g)})}, where α(g) = 0 for rotations and 1 for reflections. This page:
- (67)-(68) build the canonical splitting homomorphism D ≅ (D×{1,τ})_{P_ω} → Π_P^{D,τ}, g ↦ (1_{P_ω}, g̃°), using the constant path at P_ω.
- (69) Its value on ω is ρ ∈ Π_P^D, of order n: the rotation lifted at the fixed pole.
- (70)-(71) For an edge a, σ_a° is the unique non-identity element of D_P fixing a: the symmetry about the axis through the edge midpoint Q_a. Its lift σ̃_a is the antiholomorphic reflection σ_a°τ, which fixes the pole; it has order 2.
- (72) σ_a = σ̃_a τ_a = τ_a σ̃_a = (λ_a, σ_a°) is holomorphic, hence lies in Π_P^D. It is an element of order 2: the half-turn about the axis through Q_a, which is an unpunctured fixed point.
- (73) Conjugation by ρ permutes τ_a, σ̃_a, σ_a according to the action of ρ on A.
- (74)-(75) For a vertex s, ε_s = σ_a ρ = (λ_a, σ_s°) with a = a(s,ω), where σ_s° is the symmetry fixing s. The marginal NB adds ε_s^{-1} = ρ^{-1}σ_a = (λ_{a'}, σ_s°), with a' the other edge at s.

What it serves. On the next page this gives ρ_s = ε_s^2 and Π_P^D ≅ ⟨ρ, σ_{a0} | ρ^n = σ_{a0}^2 = 1⟩ ≅ Z/n * Z/2. Geometrically this is the orbifold fundamental group of Σ*/D_n. The quotient Σ/D_n is a (2,2,n) orbifold; the vertex orbit becomes a puncture replacing one order-2 cone point. For n = 3 the group is PSL_2(Z) ≅ Z/2*Z/3, containing the free group Π_P as Γ(2). This is the genus-0, 'polygon' piece of the 'Teichmüller' / dessins bookkeeping: an explicit presentation of the full symmetric (holo+antiholo) fundamental groups of the n-punctured sphere with dihedral symmetry, with explicit generators and the action of the symmetries on them.
errors: (73) is written as ρ(x) = …, meaning conjugation by ρ (inner action); this is notation rather than an error.

The equality σ̃_a τ_a = τ_a σ̃_a in (72) needs the path λ_a (from P_ω to τP_ω through Q_a) to be invariant under σ_a°τ. This holds because λ_a can be chosen along the fixed arc of that reflection, but the page does not state it.

The margin note on ε_s^{-1} carries a '(?)' in the manuscript: the identification of the path as λ_{a'} with a' the other edge at s is plausible, but depends on path orientation conventions not fixed on the page.
Equation numbering is irregular: the ε_s definition is unnumbered (it should be (74)), and (75) labels the description of σ_s°, while the next page reuses (75) for ρ_s = ε_s^2.

ideas.what: Splitting of the stabiliser of the base point (pole) into the extended fundamental group via constant paths: D → Π_P^{D,τ}
ideas.modern_name: Section of orbifold fundamental group extension at a fixed point (local group / isotropy embedding)
ideas.where_published: Groupoid-with-symmetries viewpoint appears in Esquisse d'un programme (Teichmüller tower, base points at 'points at infinity')

ideas.what: Explicit generators: ρ (order n), antiholomorphic reflections σ̃_a (order 2), holomorphic half-turns σ_a = σ̃_a τ_a (order 2), and ε_s = σ_a ρ with ε_s^2 = loop around puncture s
ideas.modern_name: Presentation of the (extended) orbifold fundamental group of the dihedrally symmetric punctured sphere; Z/n*Z/2 (Hecke-type group)

ideas.what: Use of real structure τ combined with holomorphic dihedral symmetries to get the full group D×{1,τ} acting on the punctured sphere
ideas.modern_name: Real/anti-holomorphic extended mapping class/orbifold groups; extended triangle groups
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme mentions real structures and complex conjugation on the Teichmüller tower

deep.surprise_reason: Careful but routine computation of orbifold fundamental groups (the n-punctured sphere with dihedral and anti-holomorphic symmetries, yielding Z/n*Z/2) as bookkeeping for the Teichmüller-tower / dessins programme; nothing beyond classical results.
transcription_corrections: Groups are written Π_P^D, Π_P^{D,τ} (capital Pi), not π_P.
(69): ρ := ω̃_π ∈ Π_P^D ⊂ Π_P^{D,τ}, with marginal (ρ^n = 1).
(71) reads approximately: 'σ_a° ∈ D_P est l'unique automorphisme ≠ id qui fixe a (se réalise sur Σ comme la symétrie p.r. à l'axe de Σ qui passe par Q_a)'.
Left-margin note near (71)-(72) is roughly: 'pour suivre l'exposé, on distingue g̃ de l'élément de Π_P^D qu'il représente, introduit en (72)'. This reading is uncertain.
Heading before (73): 'Notons les formules' (struck: 'On récapitule les ρ_s').
The ε_s line is equation (74): ε_s = σ_a ρ = (λ_a, σ_s°) ∈ Π_P^D, s ∈ S, où a = a(s,ω).
Bottom-left NB: 'On a ε_s^{-1} = ρ^{-1}σ_a = (λ_{a'}(?), σ_s°), où a' est l'autre arête issue de s'.
(75): 'σ_s° ∈ D_P est l'unique automorphisme ≠ 1 de P qui fixe le sommet s ∈ S'.
